name: PHP Extensions via PIE
description: Installs PHP extensions using PIE (PHP Installer for Extensions) into the PHP installation provided by a PHP runtime feature. Requires the pie feature and a PHP runtime with build tools, e.g. the official PHP devcontainer feature.

extensions.description: Comma-separated list of PIE packages to install, e.g. "apcu/apcu,xdebug/xdebug". PIE package names are Composer-style vendor/package names; per-package version constraints are supported, e.g. "xdebug/xdebug:^3.4".
